title: Mixed-sign ordering charts leave arbitrary-amplitude shared-mode gluing unresolved
statement: The preserved shared_mode_charts.py changes the fourth ray to (4,2;2,1), multiplies the second cubic target by four, and solves 24 ordering cones with minima selected for each local triad. Its stored floating results report optimal on every chart, with nine negative and fifteen positive gaps. Examples include order [1,3,2,0] at -1.0848451551652143, [2,3,0,1] at -4.137683076744265, and [3,2,1,0] at -16.301638492429536; order [2,1,0,3] has positive gap 234.56164504533118. Thus this supplied proposal is not an all-chart positive construction. The signs and solver statuses have not been converted into exact feasibility or impossibility certificates. They do not refute the earlier fixed-relative-amplitude all-phase overlapping theorem or settle independent amplitudes, arbitrary resonance networks or the full face.
